title: Postgres connection pool exhausted
symptoms: connection pool exhausted connections busy waited query timeout too many connections auth login failing
fix: Kill idle-in-transaction sessions (pg_terminate_backend), raise PgBouncer default_pool_size from 20 to 40, and roll AuthAPI pods to drop leaked connections.

title: Lock contention on users table
symptoms: query timeout could not acquire lock table rows deadlock long running migration
fix: Find the blocking PID with pg_locks, cancel the long-running migration, and re-run it with lock_timeout=5s during low traffic.

title: OrderDB pool saturated by reporting job
symptoms: connection pool exhausted orderdb connections busy query timeout nightly report
fix: Pause the nightly reporting cron, point it at the read replica, then restart OrderAPI to reset its pool.

title: InventoryDB lock storm during stock sync
symptoms: query timed out could not acquire lock inventory sync rows retry
fix: Stop the supplier stock-sync worker, let locks drain, and re-enable it with batch size 100 instead of 5000.

title: Redis failover left clients on read-only replica
symptoms: readonly can't write against read only replica redis failover session cache
fix: Run SENTINEL failover, then restart AuthAPI so the Redis client re-resolves the new primary.

title: Redis memory pressure and evictions
symptoms: eviction storm keys evicted memory maxmemory session cache
fix: Raise maxmemory to 4gb, switch policy to volatile-lru, and cut session TTL from 7d to 24h.

title: Elasticsearch cluster red after node loss
symptoms: cluster health red unassigned primary shards search index node lost
fix: Bring the lost data node back or run _cluster/reroute with allocate_stale_primary; check disk watermarks first.

title: Search thread pool saturation
symptoms: search rejected thread pool queue full pending bulk indexing
fix: Throttle bulk re-indexing to 2 workers and raise thread_pool.search.queue_size to 2000.

title: Payment provider outage
symptoms: payment gateway returned http 503 service unavailable charge provider
fix: Check the provider status page, switch PaymentAPI to the secondary provider flag payments.fallback=true, and queue failed charges for retry.

title: TLS handshake failures to payment provider
symptoms: tls handshake timed out payment gateway 443 certificate
fix: Verify the egress proxy is healthy and the provider's new CA is in the PaymentAPI truststore.

title: AuthAPI out of memory
symptoms: outofmemoryerror java heap space worker thread auth health check failed instance removed
fix: Capture a heap dump, roll back the last AuthAPI deploy, and raise -Xmx from 512m to 1g while the leak is fixed.

title: OrderAPI instances failing health checks
symptoms: health check failed instance removed from pool order api memory
fix: Scale OrderAPI to 6 replicas, then inspect the failing pod's logs for startup errors after the latest config change.

title: Gateway TLS certificate expired
symptoms: tls certificate expired rejecting https connections gateway
fix: Renew the certificate with cert-manager (kubectl cert-manager renew gateway-tls) and reload the gateway.

title: Gateway worker crash loop
symptoms: worker process exited signal segmentation fault gateway 502 bad gateway
fix: Roll the gateway back to the previous image and disable the new Lua plugin that triggered the segfault.

title: Broken frontend bundle after deploy
symptoms: bundle failed to load chunkloaderror main js cdn
fix: Invalidate the CDN cache and redeploy the previous frontend build; make sure old chunks are kept for 24h.

title: Upstream timeouts cascading through OrderAPI
symptoms: upstream request failed gateway timeout circuit breaker open connection refused retry budget
fix: Upstream timeouts are a symptom. Follow the dependency chain to the deepest failing service and fix that first; lower client timeouts to 2s to stop thread pile-up.
